notes.title: V1.1.3
notes.content:
After reading several pieces of feedback I have taken the time to add the following:

- Added options menu when playing a story. (This can only be accessed during the actual story sections). This is accessed with the escape key. 

- Added volume slider

- Added full screen mode & windowed mode toggle

- Added FPS cap (Set to 60 by default)

- Added Vsync option (select this if you want higher than 60 fps as it will match your monitors refresh rate)

Thank you to everyone who has continued to provide solid, constructive feedback. I am listening, & I am reading. Thank you for your continued support.

**Localisation for menu options is incoming** English only at current build.

notes.title: STEAM DECK SUPPORT!
notes.content:
Hello players!

We have just added full support for Steam Deck allowing you to enjoy Chronicles from the Abyss on the go. 

- Full Steam Deck support
- Language updates
